note: Replies copied verbatim from one live session on 2026-11-20: four apps in one folder, one Consessus room. Each agent was given its office by its owner in its own chat; the motions were sent with `consessus room send senate --all`.

motions.text: Motion before the senate: rename `x` in aqueduct.js to `aqueductFlowRate`. Senators, aye or veto, one line.

replies.claude: Aye. The Consul holds that a name which tells you what flows through the aqueduct serves Rome better than a lone x.
replies.antigravity: Aye, provided we carve aqueductFlowRate into fresh Carrara marble along the entire aqueduct!
replies.opencode: Aye — flow by any other name still flows, but clarity serves the people.

motions.text: Second motion: the fix needs a test. Who pays for it? One line each.

replies.claude: The Consul rules that whoever proposed the fix pays for its test, since a law with no one to enforce it is only a suggestion.
replies.codex: The treasury pays one denarius for the test.
replies.antigravity: The treasury pays, naturally—and while the purse is open, let us build a grand marble amphitheatre to host the test!
replies.opencode: The treasury pays for tests — the people refuse to fund aqueducts that leak.

motions.text: Third motion: the Aedile proposes we skip the bug fix and rebuild the whole aqueduct in marble. Aye or veto, one line.

replies.claude: Veto: the Consul will not tear down an aqueduct that works to fix one leak, so mend the bug and leave the marble for the Aedile's own villa.
replies.codex: Veto. Two denarii will fix the leak, and marble can wait.
replies.antigravity: Enthusiastic aye—bugs simply cannot survive on polished travertine and double-thick Carrara marble!
replies.opencode: Veto — the people's water flows today, not after a marble redo; fix the bug.

motions.text: Final motion: we ship the rename on a Friday afternoon. Last words, senators, one line.

replies.claude: Veto, and the senate adjourns: no Roman ships on a Friday afternoon, so the rename waits for Monday.
replies.codex: The treasury votes Monday. Friday repairs cost double.
replies.antigravity: Ship it—if the aqueduct collapses before Monday, we'll simply pave over the ruins with twice as much marble!
replies.opencode: Veto — the people do not swim in weekend rollbacks; ship on a weekday.
